description: dresscode exception patterns: derived per check from rejected matches (dresscode.mjs suggest --publish). Default: only a pattern seen in >=2 products is published; the ones with product_count 1 were deliberately chosen by the owner because they're general. Contains no product text.

patterns.reason: Content announced to a screen reader isn't a change announcement to the team.
Instructions for running a test or script aren't a guide for setting up a new screen.
The name of the "Design System Roadmap" document isn't a tie to the product roadmap.
A server/tool catalog isn't a component catalog.
